event_name: Date 27 April 2019 Time 14:25 2019 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 April 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 20), have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 23.5 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The gearbox of car 10 has been changed before 6 consecutive events have expired. This penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start from the Pit Lane for a prior infringement.
rules_referenced: Article 17.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Offence Car 10 Gearbox
